description: Source code for a script that generates reStructuredText documentation for devicetree bindings in the Zephyr project, including classes and functions for processing bindings, vendors, and generating documentation pages.

classes.name: VndLookup
classes.description: A class for looking up vendor and binding information based on vendor prefixes and compatible strings.

methods.name: load_vnd2vendor
methods.description: Loads vendor prefixes from a text file into a dictionary.

methods.name: init_vnd2bindings
methods.description: Initializes a mapping from vendor prefixes to bindings.

methods.name: init_vnd2ref_target
methods.description: Creates a mapping from vendor prefixes to reference target strings.
